This is first bail application filed on behalf of the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.274/2024 registered at Police Station Kolgawan, District Satna (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(N) and 506 of Indian Penal Code.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has falsely been implicated in the case.
Prosecutrix is major aged about 35 years.
There was long relationship between applicant and prosecutrix.
False report has been lodged against the applicant due to dispute between applicant and prosecutrix.
In these circumstances, applicant be released on bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of regular bail.
It is submitted that repeatedly rape has been committed by applicant on prosecutrix.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Considering the age of prosecutrix, relationship between applicant and prosecutrix and other facts available in case diary, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his regular appearance before trial Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during pendency of trial.
